versions.content: Service Name Eth_MacSecInitRxSc Syntax Std_ReturnType Eth_MacSecInitRxSc ( uint8 CtrlIdx, uint64 RxSci ) Service ID [hex] 0x2b ▽ △ Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different CtrlIdx, non reentrant for the same CtrlIdx CtrlIdx Index of the Ethernet controller within the context of Ethernet Driver Parameters (in) RxSci Secure Channel Identifier for the MACsec’s Reception Secure channel. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK : The request has been accecpted E_NOT_OK : The request has been rejected Description Requests the Ethernet Controller Driver to configure a Reception Secure Channel for the given Reception Secure Channel Identifier. Available via Eth.h
